programmes.d: When an American student and sex worker is murdered in Budapest, similarities to a recent case in Japan lead the Fly Team to partner with detectives from Tokyo.
The Fly Team discovers they're on the trail of a serial killer.
When an attorney is found dead near the body of a private escort, the team must piece together what connected the two seemingly random victims
After a truck filled with armor-piercing rifles is hijacked, the team works to discover who stole it, and what they have planned for the stolen weapons

After the police ignore a desperate father's plea for help, he abducts a billionaire's daughter and holds her hostage in a safe room until his own missing child is returned to him; Jubal puts his hostage negotiation skills to the test.
When the team is called to the scene of a murder, it quickly suspects political motivation; Maggie contemplates a decision that could affect her entire career.
Jess LaCroix and his team come to help OA find a fugitive LaCroix arrested years ago after a bus with 26 students goes missing and he's the main suspect.
Part one of a special three-part crossover event that brings together all three FBI teams, and the fourth season premiere of FBI.
The manhunt moves to Europe in part three of a special three-part crossover event with all three FBI teams, and the series premiere of FBI: INTERNATIONAL.
The International Fly Team is called on when a young mother flees to Hungary with her son, after losing partial custody of her son in the U.S.
The team investigates when the hijacking of millions worth of cryptocurrency en route to a safety vault in Switzerland leaves an American transporter dead and another on the run.
The team investigates when the hijacking of millions worth of cryptocurrency en route to a safety vault in Switzerland leaves an American transporter dead and another on the run.
The team investigates a drug deal gone bad after the body of a college student is found.

The team welcomes a new member, Special Agent Tiffany Wallace, as they search for killers who orchestrated a mass shooting at a media company, and OA's personal connection with the case threatens to cloud his judgement.

The team races to stop an active serial killer after three women are found weighted down at the bottom of a lake, and Jubal looks into an old closed case after there are multiple similarities to the recent victims.

When the leader of a drug cartel and one of the world's most wanted men, Antonio Vargas, is apprehended by the team, the entire FBI headquarters is put at risk when his henchmen unveil a terroristic threat to free him.
A shooting at a quienceanera leaves two dead, but the team believes they may not have been the intended targets.
